description: This file defines a PHP class 'GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate' which extends 'GenericBasicDisplayField'. The class provides functionality for mapping display fields with aggregate functions (such as MIN) for report generation within the OrangeHRM system. It maintains a static mapping array, manages aggregate settings, and generates select parts for database queries based on these mappings.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A class extending 'GenericBasicDisplayField' that adds support for aggregate functions on display fields, such as 'MIN'.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the display field parameters, including entity alias, field, and aggregate function based on a mapping.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the current aggregate function set for the display field.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregate function for the display field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates and returns the SQL select part string incorporating the aggregate function.
